children: Balle Kim, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, sold Class A common shares in three transactions on September 18, 21 and 22, 2026. The September 18 sale was a weighted average price of approximately $39.16 per share; the September 21 sale was a weighted average price of approximately $39.08 per share; the September 22 sale was at approximately $36.35 per share. The total proceeds from the sales were $1,643,224. Following these transactions, the reporting person directly owns 510 Class A common shares and indirectly owns 254 Class A common shares (by spouse).
